subject: Supplier onboarding: invoice route & PO waiver — SprintGate pilot
messages:
From: Aisha Foster <aisha.foster@sprintgate.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Leon Wu <leon.wu@sprintgate.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier onboarding request — invoice route / PO waiver for pilot

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo this week — SprintGate is excited to kick off the 8-week pilot. Our procurement team asked for clarification on onboarding so I wanted to surface one ask up front.

Context: SprintGate typically issues POs for vendor spend, but for short-term pilots we ask vendors to invoice us directly and reconcile after the pilot. To move quickly we need Redwood to accept invoice-only onboarding for this pilot (no PO issued).

What we can provide immediately:
- Completed vendor intake form (attached)
- W-9 and company banking info
- COI (certificate of insurance) if required

What we need from Redwood:
- Temporary waiver of the PO requirement for the pilot window (8–12 weeks)
- Confirmation of invoicing contact and billing recipient
- Any addendum/legal language required for no-PO billing

Can we get a quick yes/no on whether Redwood can take SprintGate on as an invoice-only supplier for the pilot? If yes, we’ll circulate W-9 + COI and aim to route the first invoice in 2 weeks.

Attachment: sprintgate_vendor_intake.pdf (Vendor intake form)

Thanks —
Aisha Foster
Head of Partnerships | SprintGate
aisha.foster@sprintgate.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Foster <aisha.foster@sprintgate.com>
Cc: Leon Wu <leon.wu@sprintgate.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 12:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding request — invoice route / PO waiver for pilot

Hi Aisha — really appreciate the quick follow-up.

Short answer: likely yes, we can support a temporary invoice-only onboarding for a limited pilot, but I need to confirm a couple of items with our procurement and sales ops teams (cc’d).

Can you send the W-9 and bank details and confirm the expected total pilot spend (estimate)? Also please include your preferred payment terms (Net30/Net45) and a preferred billing contact.

Next steps on our side:
- Priya (procurement) to confirm risk criteria and sign-off conditions
- Marissa (sales ops) to prepare a No-PO Pilot Addendum (auto-expiring) and route to finance
- I’ll share the requested items with you and get this pulled through quickly

Thanks — speak soon.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: sprintgate_vendor_intake.pdf referenced)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Supplier onboarding request — invoice route / PO waiver for pilot

Thanks Markus — reviewed SprintGate’s intake (looks complete). A few procurement notes before we present a formal waiver: 

Key conditions we require for a temporary invoice-only path:
1) W-9 and bank details on file (customer provided)
2) Certificate of Insurance naming Redwood Inference as additional insured (minimum limit: 1M GL)
3) Signed No-PO Pilot Addendum that:
   - Defines pilot dates (start/end) and aggregate spend cap ($25k unless preapproved)
   - Auto-expires at pilot end (no standing WAIVER)
   - Specifies payment terms (Net30 default)
4) Procurement needs a single point of contact for billing and an initial invoice schedule

If SprintGate can meet the items above, procurement can approve a temporary no-PO route scoped to the pilot window. I’ve attached our internal approval checklist/template for pilots so Marissa/Markus can complete and move to finance.

Attachment: pilot_approval_checklist_internal.xlsx (internal)

Priya
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Supplier onboarding request — invoice route / PO waiver for pilot

Agree with Priya — procurement conditions are standard. Two operational asks from Sales Ops/Finance side: 

- We should include an explicit spend cap and auto-expiration in the addendum so Finance can reconcile without creating a standing exception. 
- I’ve redlined the addendum language to call out receivable coding and an internal GL for pilot invoices; putting that in now avoids rework.

I attached a redline of the pilot addendum (purchase_terms_redline.docx). Markus — once you have SprintGate’s W-9, COI, and signed addendum we’ll create the vendor record and confirm the billing contact. Finance prefers Net30 unless SprintGate requests Net45 with justification.

Attachment: purchase_terms_redline.docx (redline of No-PO Pilot Addendum)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Foster <aisha.foster@sprintgate.com>, Leon Wu <leon.wu@sprintgate.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Supplier onboarding request — invoice route / PO waiver for pilot

Hi Aisha / Leon — quick update from Redwood: procurement and sales ops have approved a temporary invoice-only onboarding path for the SprintGate pilot, subject to the items below. We can onboard you as an invoice-only supplier for the pilot period once we receive the required evidence and signed addendum.

Required items (please provide):
- Completed vendor intake (received)
- W-9 (PDF)
- Certificate of Insurance naming Redwood Inference as additional insured (PDF)
- Signed No-PO Pilot Addendum (attached)

Operational details:
- Pilot window: proposed 2027-12-01 to 2028-01-26 (8 weeks)
- Spend cap: $25,000 total for pilot unless preapproved in writing by procurement
- Payment terms: Net30 (Finance default)
- Billing contact: accounts.payable@sprintgate.com (please confirm)

Attached: No-PO_Pilot_Addendum.pdf (for signature), sprintgate_vendor_intake.pdf (copied)

I’ve also created a HubSpot deal and linked DocuSign for the addendum: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9812345 — please sign the addendum in DocuSign and attach COI + W-9 to this thread. Once we have that we’ll create your vendor record and you can issue the pilot invoice.

If anything needs to be different on your side (longer term payment terms, different GL coding), flag it and we’ll route for approval — but the above is the fastest path to get you invoicing.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
(Attachments: No-PO_Pilot_Addendum.pdf; sprintgate_vendor_intake.pdf)
